prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Glasduenen", glass dunes in the desert wasteland: rolling dunes made of fused, melted glass that glitter in all colours of the rainbow, seen from above. One large walkable area: a wide flat plain of pale sand with smooth wind-ripples and scattered glittering glass fragments, filling the lower two thirds and the center of the image, open and uncluttered.
TOP EDGE: far away beyond the dunes a dark blue strip of the real sea at the horizon.
TOP LEFT: a high flat-topped glass dune plateau (the lookout dune) with a little cairn of stones and a weathered wooden marker post on top, separated from the plain by a deep narrow glowing glass canyon (a crevasse with crystal walls, turquoise and amber reflections) that runs below and to the right of the plateau; across the canyon on the right side of the plateau hangs a collapsed old rope-and-plank bridge, its broken half dangling into the gorge; on the near (right) side of the canyon stands a rusty hand-cranked cable winch on a concrete block with coiled steel cable.
TOP RIGHT: the glassblower's workshop - a small hut built from sandstone, scrap metal and colourful glass bottles set into the walls like windows, a wide open door, shelves with glass balls, glass shells and vases on the porch - the most eye-catching spot; next to it a big dome-shaped brick glass furnace with an orange glowing mouth and a chimney, firewood and a sand pile.
BOTTOM LEFT OF CENTER: a crater nest of shattered, spiky crystal shards and bone-white sand mounds, the nest of giant glass scorpions (no animals drawn), with one big oval egg-shaped hollow in the middle.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a hideout behind a half-buried rusty car wreck with a patched tarp, a few crates and stolen junk, a little fire pit.
Two small clusters of tall jagged glass crystals stand in the plain (center and lower right).
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: RIGHT edge (east), middle - a dusty dirt track with tire tracks leading off toward the road; LEFT edge (west), lower half - an old wagon track with wooden marker posts and a closed rusty barrier with a sign board (only a wave symbol, no letters), leading west toward the sea.
Light and material: no neon, bright hot desert daylight, sparkling glass with prismatic rainbow reflections, warm sand, deep blue sky reflected in the glass.
Time: midday, clear and hot.
